raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Syncs the Kimi-K3 GB200 InferenceX AgentX section with [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4322](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4322) at [`b7eee97`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/tree/b7eee972451f9297941d4cbe6d42d489d7ec8363/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/kimik3/vllm/gb200-fp4/agentx), which builds on #3748 and moves both GB200 lanes to one vLLM nightly. It changes only `recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml`.

**This PR is stacked on #62542** (the #3748 sync): that PR's commits show here until it merges, and this one will be rebased onto `main` afterwards. Only the last commit is new. InferenceX #4322 is still in review.

## Claims

- **Selector, GB200 + Prefill/Decode + Dynamo:**
  - Both roles add `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16` and `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:512`.
  - Decode `--max-num-batched-tokens` goes from 16384 to 1024. Decode batches at most 480 tokens; at the 16384 default the FlashInfer MoE autotune bucket needs a 2.9 GiB workspace that runs out of memory at 0.92 and hangs the other ranks.
  - Both roles add `NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none`, and decode now gets `VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=0`, which the lane sets on both roles (the selector rendered it for prefill only). Both are in #3748 too and were missing from #62542.
- **Guide, aggregated:** image moves to `nightly-e68efc68`, the same nightly as the disaggregated lane. The aggregated recipe is otherwise identical to #3748, so the selector is unchanged.
- **Guide, disaggregated:** image `nightly-e68efc68`, Dynamo `ffbbaaa6`, the new flags and env in both role commands, a concurrency-32 row (`S`=64, prefill 0.88/512, decode 0.92/320), and the NATS note replaced: the lane starts no NATS service and this is now covered by the qualified run.
- Left out as InferenceX-only or cluster-local: `*_eval` parser overrides (the guide already documents the parser flags), dev-mode and telemetry env, cache paths, `WITH_NVIDIA_PEERMEM=0`, AIPerf settings.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` passes in vllm-project/recipes.
- I rendered the JSON API for #62542's head and for this branch and diffed them. Only the GB200 Prefill/Decode render changes (the items above); every other hardware render is identical.
- Qualified evidence: InferenceX run [39373853347](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39373853347): all 6 aggregated points, all 3 disaggregated points (c16, c32, c48) and all 3 evals passed.
- Not done: a browser preview of the recipe route, and the full variant x hardware render matrix.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

@@ -684,11 +827,11 @@ guide: |
 
   ## GB200: InferenceX AgentX alignment
 
-  The GB200 AgentX lanes in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`kimik3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-mooncake-*`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3748](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3748), pinned to [`49a8e45`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/tree/49a8e45349cf0b4a03ffa2c6d49da1fd861586f7/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/kimik3/vllm/gb200-fp4/agentx)) serve the default `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` checkpoint (MXFP4 weights) with DSpark speculative decoding and a Mooncake KV store on 4-GPU NVL trays. They are benchmark configurations; the settings below are the production-useful parts. The builder's **Mooncake** option generates the `mooncake_master` and store config; the lane-specific connector settings are below. Throughput runs use InferenceX's golden acceptance lengths for DSpark.
 
   ### Aggregated: TP8 x PP2 + DCP8 (16 GPUs, 4 trays)
 
-  Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-ac9126e58aa7bbab1856ba6593ba4d5003fea516`, run through Dynamo's vLLM frontend with an embedded RDMA Mooncake store (`global_segment_size` 200GB, `mlx5_0..mlx5_3`). The builder's TP+PP strategy uses one pipeline stage per node (TP4 x PP4 on these 4-GPU trays), so this lane is documented as an explicit command. `C` is client concurrency, `K` is `num_speculative_tokens` and `S` is `--max-num-seqs`:
+  Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-e68efc685ab1e6f1eda004ced7157e3ca411da2f` (the same nightly as the disaggregated lane), served by vLLM's own frontend (no Dynamo) with an embedded RDMA Mooncake store (`global_segment_size` 200GB, `mlx5_0..mlx5_3`). In the command builder, select GB200, **Multi-Node TP + Pipeline Parallel** and the **Python** frontend (the lane did not enable the Rust frontend): on GB200 it renders this TP8 x PP2 + DCP8 layout across four trays with the K4 draft and `--max-num-seqs 64` (the C=32 row). Leave **Spec decoding** off, because the toggle replaces the K4 draft with the generic `RedHatAI/Kimi-K3-speculator.dspark` K8 draft. The builder's **Mooncake** KV Offload option renders a plain `MooncakeStoreConnector` with a 100GB segment; use the lane's connector and 200GB store from the command below. The per-concurrency settings below stay manual. `C` is client concurrency, `K` is `num_speculative_tokens` and `S` is `--max-num-seqs`:
 
   | C | K | S | `cudagraph_capture_sizes` (before the shared tail) |
   |---:|---:|---:|---|
@@ -703,7 +846,10 @@ guide: |
   ```bash
   export VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_A2A=1 VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_Q_GATHER=1 VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_KV_GATHER=1
   export VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=1 NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1

@@ -714,35 +860,66 @@ guide: |
     --speculative-config '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":<K>,"attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
     --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[<sizes from the table>,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192]}' \
     --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"enable_offload":false}}' \

This is a different layout from the TEP8/DEP profile above, tuned for long-context agentic traffic with a shared Mooncake store, so it is documented here rather than in the builder. Each role is four trays. Both roles run:
+  Image `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-e68efc685ab1e6f1eda004ced7157e3ca411da2f` with Dynamo `ffbbaaa6c44370e798687881317535ac17d66a76`, etcd and an embedded RDMA Mooncake store. The lane's request plane is TCP (`DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp`) and it starts no NATS service. Each role is one worker across four trays.
+
+  In the command builder, select GB200, **Prefill/Decode Disaggregation** and the **Dynamo** PD router, and keep the default TP prefill and TP decode pools: they render this TP16 + DCP16 layout with the concurrency-16 settings. The profile already includes the DSpark K4 draft and `--language-model-only`, so leave **Spec decoding** off (the toggle swaps in the generic RedHat K8 draft) and untick **Tool calling** (see the parser note below). The DEP decode pool is not supported on GB200: it renders TP1 with `--decode-context-parallel-size 16`, which vLLM rejects. The NIXL + Mooncake store connector, the Mooncake master, prefill `--kv-events-config` and the frontend's router mode and session affinity below are documented here only.
+
+  Run each command on all four trays of the role with the same `--master-addr` (the first tray's address), `--nnodes 4`, `--node-rank 0` to `3`, and `--headless` on ranks 1-3. Prefill (`P_GPU`/`P_CAP` and `S` from the table below):
 
   ```bash
-  vllm serve moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --trust-remote-code \
+  python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --served-model-name moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+    --disaggregation-mode prefill --request-plane tcp \
+    --nnodes 4 --node-rank <0-3> --master-addr <first-tray-ip> --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 16 --decode-context-parallel-size 16 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \
+    --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA \
+    --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true}' \
+    --speculative-config '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
+    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 --enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 --language-model-only \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization <P_GPU> --max-num-seqs <S> --max-cudagraph-capture-size <P_CAP> \
+    --enable-cumem-allocator --stream-interval 10 --load-format safetensors --safetensors-load-strategy lazy \
+    --trust-remote-code \
+    --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}' \
+    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"compact_group_io":true,"max_load_batch_keys":2,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
+  ```
+
+  Decode (`D_GPU`/`D_CAP` and `S` from the table below). `--max-num-batched-tokens 1024` bounds the FlashInfer MoE autotune to the token counts decode can reach (at most 480); at vLLM's 16384-token default the autotune bucket needs a 2.9 GiB workspace that runs out of memory at 0.92, and the other ranks hang:
+
+  ```bash
+  python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --served-model-name moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+    --disaggregation-mode decode --request-plane tcp \
+    --nnodes 4 --node-rank <0-3> --master-addr <first-tray-ip> --device-ids 0,1,2,3 \
     --tensor-parallel-size 16 --decode-context-parallel-size 16 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \
     --attention-backend TOKENSPEED_MLA \
     --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true}' \
     --speculative-config '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
-    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 --language-model-only \
+    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 --enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 128 --language-model-only \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization <D_GPU> --max-num-seqs <S> --max-num-batched-tokens 1024 --max-cudagraph-capture-size <D_CAP> \
+    --enable-cumem-allocator --stream-interval 10 --load-format safetensors --safetensors-load-strategy lazy \
+    --trust-remote-code \
     --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"compact_group_io":true,"max_load_batch_keys":2,"enable_cross_layers_blocks":false,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
   ```
 
+  For tool calling and reasoning output, add `--reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-tool-call-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-reasoning-parser kimi_k3 --dyn-enable-structural-tag` to both roles. `python3 -m dynamo.vllm` parses the remaining arguments as vLLM engine arguments only, so `--enable-auto-tool-choice` and `--tool-call-parser` are rejected there.
+
   Per-concurrency settings (`--max-num-seqs` is 2x concurrency on both roles; decode `--max-cudagraph-capture-size` is `max-num-seqs x (4 + 1)` tokens):
 
-  | C | `--max-num-seqs` | Prefill `--gpu-memory-utilization` / `--max-cudagraph-capture-size` | Decode `--gpu-memory-utilization` / `--max-cudagraph-capture-size` |
+  | C | `S` (`--max-num-seqs`) | Prefill `P_GPU` / `P_CAP` | Decode `D_GPU` / `D_CAP` |
   |---:|---:|---|---|
   | 16 | 32 | 0.88 / 512 | 0.92 / 160 |
+  | 32 | 64 | 0.88 / 512 | 0.92 / 320 |
   | 48 | 96 | 0.88 / 512 | 0.90 / 480 |
 
   Decode memory utilization is 0.92 while the capture size is at most 320 tokens and 0.90 above it.
 
-  - **Environment (both roles):** the three direct-DCP variables, `VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=1`, `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, `NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1`, `VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS=4` and `MC_SLICE_SIZE=1048576`.
-  - **Frontend:** the Dynamo frontend runs with `--router-mode least-loaded --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 900`, so each conversation sticks to one worker and reuses its prefix cache. The Rust frontend is selected with `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1`, with `DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600` and `DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592`. AgentX sends the conversation ID as the Dynamo session ID.
+  - **Environment (both roles):** the three direct-DCP variables, `VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=1`, `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, `VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=0`, `VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM=0`, `VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS`, `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL=0`, `NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL`, `NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none`, `VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS=4`, `MC_SLICE_SIZE=1048576`, `MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY=1`, `UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE=n`, `UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE=n`, `UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED=1024`, `UCX_TCP_AF_PRIO=inet`, `VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS=0`, `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600`, `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800`, `ETCD_LEASE_TTL=600`, `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:512` and `DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp`.
+  - **Frontend:** the Dynamo frontend runs with `--router-mode least-loaded --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 900`, so each conversation sticks to one worker and reuses its prefix cache. The Rust frontend is selected with `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1`, with `DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600` and `DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592`. AgentX sends the conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-Id` request header.
   - **Mooncake master:** `--default_kv_lease_ttl=60000 --eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 --eviction_ratio=0.10`, 128GB global segment, 4GB local buffer, RDMA over `mlx5_0..mlx5_3`.
 
   ## GB300: InferenceX AgentX disaggregated (xPyD, TP8 + DCP8 prefill and decode)
